Global Business Services (GBS) Strategy Manager

• Full-time

• Field of interest: Technology, Transformation & Data

• Level of hire: Experienced hire

Company Description

With more than 2,700 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About our team

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte’s consulting practice and consists of 350 dedicated consultants who work within all aspects of the CFO area and engage with clients to advise, transform, optimize, and operate the finance function. We have private and public as well as national and international clients across different industries and of different sizes, and we work with the lion’s share of C25 companies and public institutions.

Global Business Services (GBS) is an integral part of Deloitte’s Finance Transformation practice. The GBS team is dedicated to helping organizations transform their business operations, driving higher efficiency, effectiveness, and agility. By leveraging a comprehensive suite of services, the GBS practice supports clients in optimizing shared services, outsourcing, and global business service models to create value and enhance performance. We work in the full lifecycle of projects from strategy to design and implementation.

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Manager to join our Global Business Services (GBS) team. The ideal candidate has experience in setting up shared services organizations and a deep understanding of multi-functional GBS operations. Experience with the interplay of technology and process design in this context is preferred. This role will be pivotal in driving strategic business transformation initiatives, building effective governance structures, implementing new capabilities globally and optimizing functional processes leveraging the latest technologies.

Job Description

As a GBS Strategy Manager, you will lead large complex engagements for some of the world's biggest organizations. In this role, you will architect future-ready GBS strategies, drive end-to-end finance process transformations, and leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to enable growth and value creation. You will be responsible for leading business model transformations, setting up shared services or outsourcing solutions, and leveraging a commercial mindset to position and scale innovation. You will identify, design, and implement shared services solutions aimed at driving operational effectiveness, cost efficiencies, and organizational agility.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Identifying key client business issues and architecting end-to-end finance process transformations (e.g., R2R, O2C, P2P)

• Driving business development by responding to Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and pitching strategic solutions with a strong commercial mindset

• Evaluating and deploying innovative technologies, including GenAI and intelligent automation, to elevate client digital maturity and process performance

• Determining which techniques, delivery models, and emerging tech are best suited to serving each client's unique addressable needs

• Developing recommendations for the client in the context of overall engagement

• Leading day-to-day team activities and effectively overseeing the quality of deliverables

• Managing diverse small and big teams

Qualifications

Ideally, you have:

• Around 6-9 years of relevant experience in the GBS, Shared Services and/or Business Process Outsourcing, as well as good understanding of finance processes

• 3+ years of Direct people management experience

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

• Fluency in Danish is a big plus

What you bring to the team:

• Experience with multiple GBS pillars including, but not limited to HR, IT, Finance, Procurement, Commercial Operations, Legal

• Extensive project experience within the Shared Services, Outsourcing and/or Offshoring industry, or back-office functional optimization

• Experience with service delivery model strategy, design, implementation & optimization for multi-functional or single-function entities

• Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Exceptional interpersonal, team-building and oral and written communication skills; outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV by 30.11.2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Flexible

Please do not hesitate to contact Nadiia Novikova at nshamarina@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

H+H International A/S is a company listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen, headquartered in Copenhagen, and one of Europe’s leading producers of wall building materials. Founded in 1909, the H+H Group today operates 27 factories across Northern and Central Europe and produced 2.7 million cubic meters of autoclaved aerated concrete and calcium silicate units in 2024. In Germany, H+H is the owner or majority shareholder of 8 plants manufacturing autoclaved aerated concrete and calcium silicate units; the CWE-Region generates a combined annual turnover of more than 200 million euros and employs approximately 350 people. The Danish Office is located in Aarhus.

**Head of Sales, Nordic – based in Denmark

**

Sales oriented and analytically strong leader – with a deep understanding of the construction-/building material industry

Do you want to lead sales in a company that’s shaping the future of the construction industry? You will be responsible for the development and growth of H+H’s commercial activities in Denmark, with additional responsibility for our smaller, growing markets in Sweden and Finland – both on an operational and strategic level. You’ll own the regional sales plan, develop the markets, and lead a high-performing team, with a clear focus on performance, customer relationships, and growth in a demanding market that offers real opportunity to make your mark.

Key Responsibilities

• Revenue Ownership: Full ownership of revenue and sales targets across Denmark, Sweden and Finland.

• Team Leadership: Leading, building and developing a high-performing organisation across the Nordic markets. This includes recruit, train, motivate and coach, drive proactive, cooperative ways of working across Sales, Calculation, Technical support etc.

• Lead & develop the team Recruit, train, motivate and coach to high performance; drive proactive, cooperative ways of working.

• Key Account Management: Strengthening relationships with key customers: developers, architects, and general contractors.

• Market Development/Customer Excellence: Build and grow H+H’s position in Sweden and Finland while continuing to strengthen the core Danish market; monitoring trends and competitors across the region.

• Pricing & Commercial Models: Developing pricing strategies and commercial models tailored to each market.

• Cross-border Collaboration: Close collaboration with the delivering plant in northern Germany.

• Internal Networking: Active networking across H+H International, with particular ties to the leadership team in Region Central Western Europe.

• Digital Sales: Active use of digital sales tools and data-driven decision making.

Your Profile

• Experience: B2B sales experience at senior level, ideally in the construction or building materials industry, with exposure to Nordic markets.

• Leadership: Proven leadership experience with accountability for sales results across multiple markets.

• Communication: Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships across cultures.

• Languages: Fluency in Danish and English

• Personal skills: Driven, curious, emphatic, result oriented and analytical

• Digital Mindset: Familiarity with CRM systems and data-driven sales approaches.

• AI & Innovation: Openness to digitalization and AI-supported ways of working.

What We Offer

• Impact & Autonomy: A key role with a high degree of autonomy and real influence across three markets.

• Team & Culture: Ambitious colleagues within a company in transformation.

• Attractive Package: Competitive base salary and performance-based compensation.

• Room to Grow: The opportunity to be a part of shaping the future of H+H’s Nordic sales organisation.

How to apply

The application and selection process will be done in collaboration with Brinch & Partners. If you would like to know more about H+H and this opportunity, please feel free to contact Partner Jens Christian Jensen by telephone +45 2784 7405 or by email jc@brinchpartners.dk.

Job Description: Do you want to work on complex, business-critical problems, shape senior-level decisions and help drive the major transformation in Tryg’s CFO area?

As our new Strategic Transformation Manager, you will work at the centre of our finance transformation spanning data, systems, processes and organisation. You will help shape the direction of the transformation, bring structure to its most complex challenges and provide the insights and challenge that enable senior leadership to make the right decisions.

You will join a small Transformation Office with significant exposure and influence across the programme, working closely with senior leaders, project managers and subject-matter experts across Tryg.

About the role | Strategic thinking and hands-on transformation

The Transformation Office sits at the heart of the Finance transformation, creating clarity across the programme, challenging direction and helping ensure that critical issues are resolved.

As Strategic Transformation Manager, you will take significant ownership across the programme and act as a key sparring partner to the Head of Transformation Office.

In this role, you will:

• Shape and drive key transformation topics, bringing structure to ambiguous problems, challenging assumptions and priorities, and getting hands-on when important issues, risks or dependencies need to be resolved.

• Drive executive decision-making, turning complex topics into clear recommendations and high-quality materials for steering committees, the CFO and Executive Board.

• Act as a trusted challenger to project managers and workstream leaders, strengthening plans, connecting topics across the transformation and help create momentum and accountability around critical actions.

• Drive stakeholder alignment and change, identifying where engagement is needed and translating transformation decisions into clear narratives and communication for leaders and the wider organisation.

• Strengthen programme governance and transparency, ensuring that the right topics reach senior leadership at the right time and connecting progress, risks, resources, costs and benefits into a coherent programme view.

You will need to move comfortably between the big picture and the detail – from developing an Executive Board storyline to diving into an unfamiliar data, system or finance-process issue with subject-matter experts.

What we offer

• A front-row seat to a major transformation, turning strategic decisions into real organisational impact and change.

• A highly visible role with direct exposure to senior leaders & decision-makers across Tryg.

• The variety and intellectual challenge of consulting, working across strategy, finance and transformation on business-critical topics.

• Real opportunity to influence important decisions, challenging direction and helping solve complex transformation issues.

• A steep learning curve across finance, data, technology, processes and organisation.

• A small, high-impact & collaborative team with a strong focus on sparring, feedback and professional development.

• A strong platform for further career development & opportunities within Tryg.

About you | Consulting mindset with a drive to create impact

We are looking for someone with a strong strategic problem-solving toolkit who is equally comfortable thinking at executive level and getting into the details.

You are naturally curious and do not need to be the subject-matter expert from day one. You enjoy learning how things work, asking the questions that get to the heart of an issue.

You combine analytical rigour with pragmatism: you know when further analysis is needed and when it is time to make a recommendation or decision and move forward.

To succeed in this role we expect you to:

• Have from 4 years of relevant experience, for example from a top-tier management consultancy, in-house consulting team or a comparable strategy & transformation environment.

• Have a strong foundation in structured problem solving, executive communication, and working with senior stakeholders.

• Have proven ability to structure complex and ambiguous problems and translate them into clear recommendations.

• Be comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and subject-matter experts constructively.

• Be proactive, take ownership and naturally look ahead for emerging issues and opportunities.

• Be curious and willing to learn and dive into the details of unfamiliar topics across finance, technology, data and processes.

• Be fluent in a Scandinavian language (Danish, Swedish or Norwegian) and English.

Experience from finance or insurance is an advantage, but not a requirement.

About us | Transformation Office, CFO Area

The Transformation Office is currently a small team of 3 people within Strategic Finance & Transformation in Tryg’s CFO area.

Our role is not to run every initiative ourselves. Instead we work across the transformation to create clarity, challenge plans and assumptions, resolve cross-cutting issues and ensure that senior leadership has the insights and decision support needed to drive the programme forward.

You will join a small team with significant responsibility and exposure, where analytical curiosity, high-quality thinking and a willingness to challenge are central to how we work.

We look forward to hearing from you

Send your application and CV no later than 25 November 2026. We encourage you not to attach a photo to your CV.

We continuously invite relevant candidates for interviews, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Once the right candidate has been identified, the recruitment process will be concluded.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact at Anders Hess-Auregård, Head of Transformation Office, CFO Area at anders.hessauregaard@tryg.dk

We encourage everyone regardless of gender identity, age, background, disability or origin to apply for the position. As our Senior Reward Analyst you will join a close-knit Reward team, working cross-functionally with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and fellow "Trusties" to drive data-informed people decisions. Our mission is to deliver equitable, transparent, and market-competitive compensation and benefit programs that attract and retain top global talent. In this role, you will tackle exciting challenges—from designing total reward dashboarding and leveraging compliant AI solutions to leading key annual review cycles, equity grants, and global market benchmarking. You will also play a pivotal role in advancing our pay equity analysis, statutory gender pay gap reporting, and job architecture, directly reinforcing our commitment to an inclusive, transparent, and open-to-all workplace culture. If you are a collaborative data enthusiast eager to deliver impactful insights and elevate our global reward strategy, we would love to welcome you aboard.

What you’ll be doing:

• 
Analyze market data to inform compensation and benefit decisions that will enhance our ability to attract top talent across the countries the business operates

• 
Stay up to date with market trends and legislation to advise identify risks and opportunities

• 
Support/lead on activities required to deliver a well communicated and accurate annual salary review, bonus calculation, equity grants, benefits window and promotion cycles.

• 
Partner with Finance on budget modelling, cost analysis and scenario planning.

• 
Support the design of new/updated benefits, short term incentives and long term incentives

• 
Run regular pay equity analysis and support statutory gender pay gap reporting (EU, UK and any other applicable countries).

• 
Ensure reward practices comply with relevant employment and pay transparency regulations

• 
Maintain job architecture, levelling and job evaluation consistency across the organisation

• 
Build and maintain dashboarding to give leadership visibility on reward health

• 
Prove robust analysis on key reward topics (share dilution, range penetration, pay mix)

• 
Utilise AI in a compliant way to deliver efficient solutions

• 
Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on reward topics to gain a deep understanding of the business needs and ensure they have the data and expert advice needed to make people decisions

• 
Create and communicate clear and user friendly total reward communications and educational material (including ad hoc comms, cyclical communications, benefits communications and total reward statements)

Who you are:

• Proven experience in a reward role or associated discipline

• In-depth knowledge of key reward and HRIS processes and concepts

• Expertise working with people data and people systems / HRIS (currently Sage HR)

• Advanced spreadsheet skills with the ability to manipulate and analyse large volumes of data

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights in a clear, concise manner

• Collaborative mindset and ability to communicate cross-functionallyAbility to work autonomously and learn new skills and concepts rapidly

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Head of Engineering to join a technology-driven intelligence company serving the renewable energy industry

Please note: We do not offer relocation or sponsorship for this position, and only candidates able to work on location will be considered

Want to lead a small team of developers and data scientists while staying close to the code? Want real ownership of an established platform inside a growing 20-person startup? Want to enable a greener future by helping major energy companies decide where to invest in renewable energy?

Then this might be your next role

Join Aegir Insights and get a unique opportunity to join a workplace where you can make a difference every day, whilst being part of a young, agile and fast-paced company.

We are accelerating the transition towards renewable energy sources worldwide by providing products that enable developers, investors, consultancies, suppliers, and governments across onshore wind, offshore wind, solar, storage and data centers to make smarter decisions, faster.

As Head of Engineering, you will own the platform behind our products and build the engineering team that runs it.

The platform combines curated data on more than 100,000 renewable energy projects, geospatial analytics, and financial models

Built on a stack of

React/TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, MongoDB, AWS, and Kubernetes.

The role spans technical direction, hands-on engineering, team building, delivery, and building the engineering function in Copenhagen

You will come in at a critical time in our growth and take the lead of a small team of 5 technical profiles ranging from Software developers to data scientists

You report to the founders and work closely with our commercial team and our in-house renewable energy experts.

This is not a management-only role. It is a hands-on engineering leadership role for someone equally comfortable designing and implementing a Python service, reviewing a data model, debugging a production issue, hiring a senior engineer, and explaining an architecture decision to the board.

Your key tasks will be to

• Own the technical direction of the platform: architecture, data foundations, security, reliability and build-versus-buy decisions

• Remain hands-on: design, build and review production code, particularly across our Python/FastAPI backend, APIs, data services and platform infrastructure

• Own systems end-to-end: be willing to trace a problem from React/TypeScript through APIs and data models to MongoDB, AWS/Kubernetes and external services, and fix it at the appropriate layer

• Build the Copenhagen engineering team: define the roles, hire as the business case develops, and set an operating model that gives strong engineers real ownership

• Translate product priorities set with the founders and commercial team into a technical roadmap and delivery plan

• Raise the engineering bar: establish pragmatic patterns for architecture, testing, APIs, code review, deployment, observability and documentation - and demonstrate those standards through your own engineering work

• Lay the foundation for secure multi-tenant SaaS, including authentication, authorization and permission-aware workflows

• Own the technical foundations for AI-native products and workflows, including our MCP infrastructure and secure programmatic access to Aegir's data, analytics and financial models

During the first 6–12 months, we expect the role to remain about 50-60% hands-on while you learn the platform, establish the technical direction, and make a plan for how to grow the department.

We imagine that you

• Have an educational background in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical engineering experience

• Bring experience from similar software engineering roles

• With experience in Python, APIs, data-intensive systems, and cloud architecture, while being comfortable working across a modern React/TypeScript stack

• Ideally with experience leading engineers or engineering teams, while remaining hands-on in recent roles

• Fluent english

Extra point if you have

• Have improved a live, complex platform without reaching for a ground-up rewrite

• Have personally designed, built and operated production backend systems and APIs, including data models, authentication/authorisation, asynchronous workloads and integrations between systems

• Have experience designing data-intensive applications, analytical systems or data pipelines, and making pragmatic decisions about performance, cost and maintainability

• Pragmatic and structured: you make trade-offs explicit and tie them to cost, risk and customer value

• A people leader who hires well and gives senior engineers real ownership without losing alignment with the business

• Clear, top-down communication with founders, commercial leaders and domain experts who are not software engineers

• Comfortable in a small company: you set direction, write code and get close enough to users and the work to help the team move

• Experience with geospatial systems, financial modelling or the energy sector is an advantage Comfortable using modern AI coding tools as part of everyday engineering and interested in how AI changes software development itself - not just in adding LLM features to products

Working at Aegir Insights

Joining Aegir Insights means joining an international and dedicated team that moves with strategic intent on new ideas and enjoys learning new things. We encourage innovative and lateral thinking to achieve our goals.

We offer a respectful, diverse, and international working environment (our company language is English).

We have high ambitions, and you will take part in our growth journey by actively helping shape our culture and technical direction.

We offer a competitive remuneration package:

• Salary according to experience

• Flexible working conditions (minimum 3 office days per week in Copenhagen office)

• Subsidized lunch when working from the office

• 10% pension contribution and company pension scheme

• Insurance scheme including private health insurance

We are located in the heart of Copenhagen at Havnegade 27 st, 1058 Copenhagen.

About Aegir Insights

Aegir Insights is a technology-driven company offering decision-making software, data and intelligence products for the renewable energy sector. We combine data science and deep industry experience to help developers, investors, suppliers and governments make decisions.

Would you like to help accelerate the world's transformation to renewable energy?

miniaturised electronics used in demanding applications around the world. With subsidiaries in the UK and

Ireland, we work across borders and collaborate with colleagues and customers internationally.

We’re now looking for a curious and hands-on Marketing Student Assistant to join our commercial team in

Risskov. If you’re looking to turn what you learn in your studies into real-world experience, this is an opportunity to get involved, take responsibility and see your work make a difference in an international business.

Get hands-on marketing experience in a growing technology company

Want to see what marketing looks like beyond textbooks, lectures and theory?

At Covidence Group, you’ll get to work on real marketing materials that are used by our customers, sales team and partners. You’ll work closely with our commercial organisation and get an inside look at how marketing supports an international B2B technology business. It’s a varied role where you can combine content, design, digital marketing and practical project work — and where the work you do will be visible and have a real purpose.

What you’ll do

You’ll become part of the commercial team and help make sure our products, materials and marketing presence are always ready to go.

Your day-to-day work will include:

• Create visual content: Design banners, icons, presentations and other visual assets for digital and print use.

• Bring products to life: Keep product documentation, datasheets and other materials accurate, clear and up to date.

• Keep our digital presence fresh: Manage and update content on our customer portal.

• Make information easy to find: Maintain our digital and physical library of marketing and product materials.

• Get trade shows ready: Help prepare presentations, printed materials, product information and practical logistics for exhibitions and customer events.

• Take ownership of projects: Pick up smaller projects and special tasks as they arise, with the opportunity to shape how things are done.

This is a hands-on marketing role designed for someone who wants to learn by doing. You’ll get involved in the practical work behind B2B marketing — creating visual content, preparing marketing materials, supporting trade shows and helping turn ideas into something tangible. It’s a varied role where you’ll gain experience across different areas of marketing rather than focusing on just one.

You’re the right person if you

• Are studying marketing, communications, multimedia design, business, or a similar field

• Are looking for a role where you can put your knowledge into practice and gain hands-on experience

• Are organised, independent and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage different tasks and priorities

• Have strong, natural English writing skills and feel confident communicating in English

• Enjoy turning information into clear, useful and professional content

• Have experience with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus

• Have some experience with content creation or document management – this is an advantage, but not a requirement

Most importantly, you’re curious, willing to learn and happy to get stuck into a variety of tasks.

You will work primarily from our office in Risskov. As the role involves close collaboration with the commercial team and hands-on work with physical materials, being comfortable working on-site is important.

What we offer

• A paid, part-time student position in a growing international technology company

• Real responsibility from day one – your work will be used and have a visible impact

• The opportunity to build practical experience across content, design, digital marketing and B2B communications

• A varied role where you can learn, contribute and take ownership

• A small and collaborative team where you’ll work closely with colleagues across the business

• The opportunity to see how marketing connects with products, sales and customers in an international company

If you’re looking for a student job where you can create things, learn how a real business works and see the results of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

How to apply

Send a CV and a short note (3–4 paragraphs, not a generic cover letter) explaining why you are a good fit for this role. If you have a portfolio or other relevant examples of your work, you are also welcome to include or share it as part of your application.

Please submit your application through: www.covidence.com/job-openings

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to Mathias Borg on email: mbo@covidence.com.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. • 
Act as a trusted analytics partner to Global eCommerce leadership, shaping priorities and key business decisions.

Identify growth opportunities across traffic, conversion, customer and product performance, and turn them into clear commercial recommendations.

Lead deep dives into the key drivers of eCommerce performance and translate findings into actions that move the business.

Define the KPIs and frameworks used to track and steer eCommerce growth.

Continuously sharpen analytical approaches and decision-making tools.

Analytics strategy & Centre of Excellence

Define the analytics strategy, priorities and roadmap for Global eCommerce.

Lead Pandora's global eCommerce analytics community and set the standard for how analytics creates business value.

• 
Build analytical and commercial capability across the organisation through coaching and knowledge sharing.

eCommerce analytics platforms

Act as business owner of Pandora's key eCommerce analytics platforms, ensuring they answer the questions that matter most to the business.

• 
Lead the Centre of Excellence around these platforms, connecting business needs with technology teams and vendor partners.

• 
Ensure stakeholders can rely on trusted, decision-ready data.

Team leadership

• 
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing analytics team.

• 
Build capabilities in analytics, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.

• 
Foster a collaborative, curious and commercially minded culture.

What is needed to succeed

We imagine that you bring significant experience within eCommerce analytics, commercial analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, combined with a passion for translating data into business value and strategic impact.

Furthermore, we are looking for someone who has:

• 
Extensive experience working within eCommerce, digital, or commercial analytics environments.

• 
A strong track record of using analytics and insights to influence business strategy, trading performance, and commercial outcomes.

• 
Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data-driven recommendations.

• 
Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to broader commercial objectives.

• 
Experience identifying growth opportunities and proactively defining analytical priorities and agendas.

• 
Experience leading and developing high-performing analytics teams.

• 
Strong knowledge of digital performance analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• 
Experience acting as business owner of web analytics platforms, ideally Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools.

• 
Experience setting the analytics agenda and ways of working within a global organisation.

• 
Experience working in complex, matrixed, international environments.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical approaches.

• 
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

• 
A continuous improvement mindset and passion for cultivating data-driven cultures.

We hope to see that you are:

• 
A commercially minded analytics leader who naturally connects data to business outcomes.

• 
A strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers of performance.

• 
Comfortable moving between executive-level discussions and analytical deep dives.

• 
Curious, proactive, and confident challenging assumptions with data and insights.

• 
An inspiring people leader and coach.

• 
A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and translate analytics into actionable recommendations.

• 
Skilled at influencing stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• 
Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

• 
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced international environment.

• 
Passionate about driving business performance through customer, commercial, and digital insights.

Your new team

You will join Pandora's Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights team, a critical function enabling data-driven growth across our global digital business.

Working closely with commercial, trading, marketing, product, technology, and analytics stakeholders, you will help shape the future of eCommerce analytics at Pandora and ensure insights play a central role in how we grow and evolve our digital business.

Additional information

• Global Career Band: 4A

Did we get your attention?

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

Focused

• After sales support

• Market analyzes and assessments

• Logistics

• Responsible for personal budgets

It is a must that you are a skilled communicator in writing and speaking, and that you master English at negotiation level.

Experienced trader

You are passionate about being in a visionary, hectic and results-driven environment, where you are approachable and deliberate, while working well prepared and attentively, focussing on the customer and his needs. You are able to do it right the first time and can take the long haul that leads to results.

Why are you choosing this job?

You are motivated to work in a modern company, with focus on personal well-being and development and characterized by short chains of command and a very high level of information. In addition to sales, you are driven by:

• Fast pace with flexible work hours

The salary consists of a small fixed salary, benefits and a a very attractive commision scheme.
